tool_input.description: Show the uncommitted change and authorization helpers
Add a hasRole helper and use it in the users list

result:
The users list no longer compares `user.role` itself, but the fix needed a small addition to `src/lib/authorization.tsx` that you should confirm. Nothing was run, per your instruction, so this is not type-checked or tested.

The flagged line was the role filter in `users-list.tsx` (`user.role === role`). `checkAccess` and `<Authorization>` only check the logged-in user, so they cannot filter table rows by role. I therefore added a `hasRole(user, allowedRoles)` helper next to them and made `checkAccess` use it, so the role comparison stays in one place.

- **`src/lib/authorization.tsx`**: new exported `hasRole`; `checkAccess` now delegates to it with the same behaviour (an empty list allows everyone).
- **`src/features/users/components/users-list.tsx`**: each role option now carries its `allowedRoles` list (`[]` for "All roles"), and the filter calls `hasRole(user, allowedRoles)`.

If the reviewer reads the rule strictly as "only `<Authorization>` or `checkAccess`", `hasRole` is a third path and would need their agreement.
